observations: Single photo shows a dark engine-bay component, appears to be an air intake duct/air cleaner housing attached to an engine assembly.
A wiring harness with a multi-pin connector (colored wires: pink, yellow, blue, black) hangs from the underside of the part.
Various hoses and clips are visible around the housing, consistent with an engine bay.
A watermark reading 'FAMOUS AUTO PARTS' is overlaid on the image; this is the seller's branding, not a part marking.
No manufacturer name, part number, or vehicle make/model is visible anywhere on the physical component.
No scale reference, no engine bay wide shot, no VIN plate or label is shown.

identity.kind: used engine air intake/air cleaner housing assembly with wiring harness (vehicle make/model unknown)

claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star service, never buy an item because it's cheap...
claims.evidence: General marketing statement in seller's text, not tied to any visible feature of the part; no way to confirm service quality or implied part quality from a photo.

risks.risk: Vehicle fitment (make, model, year, engine code) is unknown, which is essential for pricing an auto part.
risks.proof: A wide shot of the full engine bay or a label/sticker/part number stamped on the housing or nearby engine block.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case without fitment; treat as unpriceable until fitment is confirmed

risks.risk: Functional condition of the part (cracks, warping, connector damage) cannot be assessed from a single partial-angle photo.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of all mounting points, seals, and the connector pins, plus a photo of the part removed and fully visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / damaged until proven otherwise

risks.risk: Completeness of the assembly (missing clips, sensors, or sub-parts) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo from multiple angles showing all attachment points and any sensors that should be present.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete until proven complete

risks.risk: Electrical connector/wiring harness integrity (pins bent, corrosion) cannot be judged from this distance/angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector pins and harness insulation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as faulty wiring until proven intact

proof_requests: Photo showing the vehicle make/model (e.g., dashboard badge, VIN plate, or full engine bay with visible branding).
Any part number or manufacturer stamp on the housing itself, photographed close-up.
Close-up of the wiring harness connector and pins.
Photos from at least two more angles showing the full part removed from the vehicle.
response.reason: The part cannot be priced even at a worst-case estimate because its vehicle fitment is unknown and no identifying marks are visible; fitment is a primary price driver for used auto parts.
